leadText: The Mysterious Beauty (Japanese: なぞの美少女·ジンジャー登場 Enter the Mysterious Beauty Ginger) is the 37th chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.
plainText:
The Mysterious Beauty (Japanese: なぞの美少女·ジンジャー登場 Enter the Mysterious Beauty Ginger) is the 37th chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.

==Plot==
 
A beautiful woman, called "big sister" by Coconut, comes to town.

==Major events==
Ginger and her are introduced.
===Debuts===
Ginger
====Pokémon debuts====

==Characters==
===Humans===
Ginger
Coconut
Grandpa
Hazel
Almond

===Pokémon=== 
( )
( )
( )
( 

==Trivia==
This chapter was originally released between Poké-Mom and Green Jealousy, in Ciao magazine, under the title ジンジャー来襲 (Ginger Invasion).
===Errors===
In the English translation by VIZ Media, the cover for this chapter was labelled with the title of the next chapter, Swimming with the Qwilfish. This error is not present in the Chuang Yi version.
